尺寸与定位，一次核对。Check dimensions and locations together.

“原图”来自标注；“推导”由标注计算；“教学设定”用于跟做，不代表原题精确要求。Source dimensions come from drawing annotations; derived dimensions are calculated from them. Chosen teaching values support the tutorial and are not exact source requirements.

本教程如何描述位置How this tutorial describes locations

教学坐标 (u,v,h) 对应 SOLIDWORKS 全局 (X,Y,Z)=(u,h,−v)。Front Plane 为 v=0；Top Plane 为 h=0；Right Plane 为 u=0。草图尺寸优先相对原点或实体边标注。Teaching coordinates (u,v,h) correspond to SOLIDWORKS global coordinates (X,Y,Z)=(u,h,−v). Front Plane is v=0; Top Plane is h=0; Right Plane is u=0. Prefer to dimension sketches relative to the origin or solid edges.

“中面”输入总厚；“给定深度”输入本次增量；“贯穿全部”必须核对方向箭头。For Mid Plane, enter the total thickness; for Blind, enter the depth added or removed by this feature. For Through All, check the direction arrow.

把操作与原题放在一起看。Compare the instructions with the source question.

原 PDF 提供几何与要求；本页的按钮顺序、约束方法和检查点由教程补写。The original PDF supplies the geometry and requirements. This tutorial adds the command sequence, constraint methods, and checks.

所有题目的共通要求Requirements shared by all questions

  1. 每张草图完全定义。Fully define every sketch.
  2. 按第一角投影辨认正面、上面和右面。Identify the front, top, and right views using first-angle projection.
  3. 原点按图中红点/粉点放置。Place the origin at the red or pink point in the drawing.
  4. 逐题核对单位，不把所有尺寸都按 mm 输入。Check the units for each question; do not enter every dimension in mm.

    在 SOLIDWORKS 中保存与修改Save and edit in SOLIDWORKS

    按 Ctrl+S 保存 Q1.sldprt … Q5.sldprt。右键草图 → 编辑草图；右键特征 → 编辑特征。拖动设计树底部的退回控制棒，可以回看之前的实体状态。Press Ctrl+S to save Q1.sldprt … Q5.sldprt. Right-click a sketch → Edit Sketch; right-click a feature → Edit Feature. Drag the rollback bar at the bottom of the design tree to inspect earlier solid states.
